# Ben Court

## About
Ben Court is a Cardiff-based senior front-end developer currently working at Utility Warehouse. His work focuses on front-end engineering, accessibility, performance optimisation, and progressive web applications.

## Background
Ben has over fifteen years of professional web development experience and has worked across agency, in-house product, and startup environments. He has a strong focus on mobile-first design, accessible interfaces, and front-end architecture.
